def f(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g); out=np.zeros_like(a)
    # find palette: vertical bar (rows with single color runs, >=2 colors stacked, width>=2?) 
    # palette = maximal vertical stripe of multicolor rows; shape = other colored object
    # detect contiguous colored regions by rows
    colored=[r for r in range(a.shape[0]) if a[r].max()>0]
    # group contiguous row bands
    bands=[]; s=colored[0]; p=colored[0]
    for r in colored[1:]:
        if r!=p+1: bands.append((s,p)); s=r
        p=r
    bands.append((s,p))
    pal=None; shp=None
    for (r0,r1) in bands:
        cols=[c for c in range(a.shape[1]) if a[:,c].max()>0 and r0<=max(rr for rr in colored if a[rr,c].max()>0)<=r1]
        sub=a[r0:r1+1]; 
        cols=[c for c in range(a.shape[1]) if sub[:,c].max()>0]
        # palette: rows have different single colors each (bar), shape: rows have multiple cells
        rowcolors=[set(sub[i][sub[i]>0]) for i in range(sub.shape[0])]
        if all(len(rc)==1 for rc in rowcolors) and len(set(next(iter(rc)) for rc in rowcolors))>1 and len(cols)>1:
            pal=(r0,r1,cols[0],cols[-1])
        else:
            shp=(r0,r1,cols[0],cols[-1])
    r0,r1,c0,c1=pal
    colors=[int(a[r,c0]) for r in range(r0,r1+1) if a[r,c0]>0]
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=shp
    shape=a[sr0:sr1+1,sc0:sc1+1]
    h=sr1-sr0+1
    per=h-1
    idx1=colors.index(1)
    drawn=[]
    for i,col in enumerate(colors):
        start=sr0+(i-idx1)*per
        for dr in range(h):
            for dc in range(shape.shape[1]):
                if shape[dr,dc]>0:
                    out[start+dr, sc0+dc]=col
        drawn.append(i)
    return out.tolist()

import numpy as np, json
def f(g):
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape; out=np.zeros_like(a)
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if (a[r]>0).any()]
    # palette rows: each row exactly one nonzero cell
    pal_rows=[r for r in rows if (a[r]>0).sum()==1]
    # contiguous palette block
    blocks=[]; s=pal_rows[0]; p=s
    for r in pal_rows[1:]:
        if r!=p+1: blocks.append((s,p)); s=r
        p=r
    blocks.append((s,p))
    pb=max(blocks,key=lambda b:b[1]-b[0])
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if a[pb[0]:pb[1]+1,c].max()>0]
    colors=[int(a[r,cols[0]]) for r in range(pb[0],pb[1]+1) if a[r,cols[0]]>0]
    mask=(a>0)
    mask[pb[0]:pb[1]+1,:]=False
    rws=np.where(mask.any(1))[0]; cls=np.where(mask.any(0))[0]
    top=rws[0]
    h=rws[-1]-rws[0]+1
    if len(set(a[mask].tolist()))>1:
        tops={int(c):np.where((a>0)&(a==c))[0].min() for c in set(a[mask].tolist())}
        period=tops[colors[colors.index(1)+1]]-tops[1] if 1 in tops and colors.index(1)+1<len(colors) else h-1
    else:
        period=h-1
    for i,col in enumerate(colors):
        off=(i-colors.index(1))*period
        for r in range(top, rws[-1]+1):
            for c in cls:
                if mask[r,c]:
                    rr=r+off
                    if 0<=rr<H: out[rr,c]=col
    return out.tolist()
